title: From cup to aquarium
alt: Four illustrated steps: open a tissue-culture cup, rinse away growing medium, separate small portions, and plant. Substrate-planting example only.
caption: Original schematic: substrate planting is shown. Keep Anubias rhizomes exposed; follow the species instructions.

title: Two different water replacements
alt: Evaporation removes water but leaves salt behind: top off with appropriate fresh water. A saltwater water change removes both: replace with prepared saltwater.
caption: Original schematic, not a dosing chart. Verify the cause of a water-level change and measure salinity.

title: The jobs inside a filter
alt: Mechanical media trap particles; biological media host microbes; chemical media target substances. A medium can perform more than one job.
caption: Original schematic. Identify each medium’s job and follow the filter manufacturer’s care instructions.

title: How a new tank builds its biofilter
alt: Schematic: fish waste and food become ammonia; bacteria turn ammonia into nitrite, then nitrate; water changes remove nitrate. Stock lightly for the first weeks and test until nitrite falls.
caption: Original schematic of the nitrogen cycle in a new aquarium; simplified and not to scale.

title: A water-test log entry
alt: Three test vials beside a log card listing tank, date and time, test and kit, result with units, context and the next check. Example entry only, not a target value.
caption: Original schematic of a test-log entry; the values are an example, not a recommended level.
